title: Agriculture and farming industry
summary: This page provides information and links for various services related to agriculture and the farming industry in NSW.

Landholder renewable energy and transmission projects

faqs.q: Where can I find information about animal harvesting and management?
faqs.a: You can find information about animal harvesting and management at the Animal harvesting and management page.

faqs.q: What are the options for funding for primary producers?
faqs.a: Funding options include the Drought Ready and Resilient Fund, which offers low-interest loans up to $250,000, and Disaster Assistance through the Rural Assistance Authority.

faqs.q: How do I manage crop harvesting schemes?
faqs.a: You can apply to move a grape harvester in the Hunter Valley or learn about the Grain Harvest Management Scheme.

faqs.q: What services are available for transporting goods in the farming industry?
faqs.a: Services cover road freight and heavy vehicles.
